channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Not a single Democrat in the Colorado legislature says Jared Polis should reduce Tina Peters’ sentence. He appears set to do it anyway.
item.description: The Colorado Sun asked every Democrat in the legislature Wednesday whether Polis should offer Peters clemency after the governor all but said on social media Tuesday that he plans to do so

item.title: Measles cases in Broomfield now an outbreak, unvaccinated students at two schools sent home for 21 days
item.description: Latest case involves a child connected to Broomfield Heights Middle School

item.title: Opinion: Colorado child care crisis has to be addressed. We have 2 bills that would help.
item.description: Streamlining systems to improve access for family and finding ways to reduce barriers are a start to helping Colorado families

item.title: Dog that killed 7-year-old Gunnison boy showed aggressive behavior and was days from being euthanized, records show
item.description: Internal emails and text messages between staff at the Montrose Animal Shelter and a rescue group detail escalating behavior concerns before the pit bull mix was transferred to a foster family

item.title: Colorado pushes back against Trump’s campaign for coal with new court appeal
item.description: Attorney General Phil Weiser asks 10th Circuit to overturn EPA rejection of a state clean air plan that requires closing coal plants

item.title: How Colorado Ballet’s chance on a 23-year-old dancer led to him becoming a preeminent choreographer
item.description: Christopher Wheeldon’s interpretation of “A Midsummer Night’s Dream” returns to the Ellie Caulkins Opera House for 7 performances

item.title: Michael Bennet is leveling criticism at Colorado Gov. Jared Polis as he vies to replace him
item.description: During a recent debate, Bennet said Polis is “allergic” to building big statewide coalitions. At another gathering, Bennet said he totally disagrees with the idea that the governor’s health care policies have worked.

item.title: What’s Happening: A stand-up comedy smorgasbord in Aspen
item.description: Plus: A 10-minute comedy competition, square dancing in a historic grange, and three spring shows at the MCA

item.title: Overnight storm could dump 14 inches of snow on northwestern Colorado, prompting travel warnings
item.description: The Front Range foothills could see between 4 and 10 inches with 35 mph gusts, while lighter snow is expected in Denver

item.title: Suspect in custody in Colorado in the case of 3 women found dead in Utah
item.description: The 22-year-old man abandoned a stolen vehicle in Pagosa Springs and was found after a short search. He’ll appear in Colorado court Friday.
